QUARTERLY FINANCIAL REPORT - Q3 2026
Global Logistics & Technology Corp.

Section 1: Executive Overview
The Corporation delivered resilient operating performance during the third quarter.
Revenue increased 8.2% year-over-year driven by digital supply chain expansion.
- Total operating revenue reached $482.5 million.
- Operating cash flow improved by 14.3% across core logistics units.
- Cloud automation software subscriptions grew 27.5%.

Section 4: Forward-Looking Statements
Certain disclosures contained herein constitute forward-looking statements:
1. Projected capital expenditures remain subject to supply chain market conditions;
2. Regulatory clearance in European ports is anticipated by fourth quarter;
3. Technology investments may fluctuate based on enterprise adoption cycles.
